source.title: Wind blowing into some cactus spine, on the top of the mountain, in the desert of Atacama (Chile).
source.author: felix.blume
source.prepare: python scripts/sound-clean.py <file> wind_matched.wav --match <the mod's old ambient/outside/wind.ogg> 0.5, then --source wind_matched.wav
source.notes: 96 kHz 24-bit stereo, 120 s: strong gusts for the first 45 s, a lull, a gust at 60 s, calmer after 65 s; low thumps at 110-111 s. The old wind loop (43.7 s at 96 kHz, credited to this recording) matches no part of it at any speed: replaced 2026-11-10 by a loop of it, given the old loop's tone (much darker over 1 kHz) with --match. 0.5-63 s: the gusts, the lull and the next gust.
